title: Identify the distinct molecule IDs that contain at least one phosphorus ato
question: Identify the distinct molecule IDs that contain at least one phosphorus atom bonded via a double bond and also include hydrogen atoms in carcinogenic molecules.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m."XCL_010"
FROM molecule AS m
INNER JOIN atom AS a_p ON m."XCL_010" = a_p."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN bond AS b ON a_p."XCL_002" = b."XCL_005"
WHERE a_p."XCL_003" = 'p'
  AND b."XCL_006" = '='
  AND m."XCL_011" = '+'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS a_h
    WHERE a_h."XCL_002" = m."XCL_010"
      AND a_h."XCL_003" = 'h'
  )
